author: igv4321
body:
This is a bug fix taking care of the features not properly addressed in the PR #49556. Classes MahiFit and PulseShapeFitOOTPileupCorrection make certain assumption about Hcal pulse shapes and memoize results of the internal calculations. Now these memoized results are reset for every run in MahiFit and memoization is disabled in PulseShapeFitOOTPileupCorrection in the particular case when Hcal reco is configured to use pulse shapes stored in the database.

Normal matrix tests were run.

In addition to normal matrix tests, some private validation was performed in which the pulse shapes were written into a private database, and that database was used for Hcal rechit reconstruction.

This fix will need to be backported to 17_0 for potential Run 3 rereco scenarios.
title: Resetting memoized pulse shapes in MahiFit for every run
